content.text: {"scores":{"legibility":9,"sequence":9,"beat_discipline":9,"style":10,"truth_visual":10},"issues":[{"at_seconds":19,"severity":"low","rule":"beat_discipline / truth_visual","saw":"During the vault sealing phase (19s) and coin transfer (20s-24s) of the settled order, the bottom caption still reads 'Gemini agent asked for 1.5 USDC payment' before updating to 'Settled on Base Sepolia...' at 25s.","expected":"Captions and stage beats can stay tightly synchronized as the packet is sealed by the vault and the buyer sends the coin.","fix":"Optional polish: keep or slightly tighten the transition between the vault seal, coin flight, and the settled caption, though the current sub-step sequence is already clear and accurate."},{"at_seconds":25,"severity":"low","rule":"legibility","saw":"At 25s, the orderId token pill in the bottom caption bar wraps onto a second line ('ord_99b70e93-7b65-4edd-a97f-' on line 1, '8464c86f2b0d' on line 2) because the main caption text is long.","expected":"The orderId badge should ideally stay on a single line without awkward mid-UUID wrapping.","fix":"Add `white-space: nowrap` to the orderId pill span in the caption bar and allow flex-wrap on the container or slightly reduce the pill font-size so the UUID stays intact on one line."}],"verdict":"pass"}
